name: Alugu
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Gonzalez Perez, Manuel David. 2022. Grammar, dimension and deixis in Phola, a Tibeto-Burman language of China. PhD thesis, Australian National University.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: online with a university library login
sources.note: Alugu named once in the introduction (list of Phula languages with innovative endonyms); no Alugu data. Its stress section (3.1.4.4, pp. 56-58) concerns Luodie Phola [ypg], a different (Upriver) language.

sources.citation: Lama, Ziwo Qiu-Fuyuan. 2012. Subgrouping of Nisoic (Yi) Languages. PhD dissertation, University of Texas at Arlington. (Glottolog ref for alug1235)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: 0 occurrences of Alugu, Phupha, Phuza or Phupa in the text; 'stress' absent from the dissertation. Nothing on Alugu.

sources.citation: Pelkey, Jamin R. 2011. A Phula Comparative Lexicon: Phola, Phuza, Muji, Phowa, Azha. SIL Language and Culture Documentation and Description 18. Dallas: SIL International. 144 pp. (Alugu: clade map p.3; sec. 4.1 p.13; sec. 4.5 'The Downriver meso-clade of Riverine Phula' pp.15-16; sister-lect sketch sec. 3.2 'Phuza phonology in brief' pp.6-7)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Silent: 0 occurrences of stress/stressed/unstressed/accent in the whole file. Alugu appears only in tone-class history (sec. 4.5: Riverine *checked-tone merger reflex /55/ 'with shifts to high-falling /52/ in Alugu'; TC-2/3 merger 'later shifted to unmarked low-falling /21/ in Alugu'). No Alugu sketch; the Downriver representative sketch is the sister lect Phuza (four lexical tonemes /55 33 13 31/, non-contrastive tense voice on /13/, sandhi).

sources.citation: Glottolog languoid alug1235 (refs Pelkey 2011; Lama 2012; Ethnologue 2025; ISO 2007-087) and English Wikipedia 'Phupha language' (Alugu language redirects there)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Records only; no phonology. Note zh.wikipedia '阿鲁语' (Alu, unclassified Lawu-type Loloish of Jinping etc.) is a different language and was not used.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority / Pelkey, Jamin R. 2007. Change Request 2007-087: create [aub] Alugu (adopted 2008-01-14), with Request for New Language Code Element [aub]. SIL International. 8 + 5 pp.
